parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication application. You can view the ID in [ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication application management](~~2355593~~). Navigate to **ApsaraVideo Live > Live+ > Real-time Communication > Application Management** to view your application IDs.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time for the query. The query granularity must be ≥ 5 minutes and ≤ 31 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity for the query data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- 3600 (default).

- 86400.

parameters.name: RecordMode
parameters.description:
The recording mode. Valid values:

- 0: single-stream recording mode.

- 1: stream mixing recording mode.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time).
